column1: # Policy conformance matrix. One ordinary HTTP request per row, sent with curl
# expect:  a status code (e.g. 201)  -> must be answered with exactly that code
#          denied                    -> 401/403 from the mesh, or no connection
#          refused                   -> the connection itself must fail
# token:   a fixture name from cmd/tokengen, or "-" for none
# body:    JSON request body, or "-" for none
